generation.committed_lengths.equation: committed_length[b] := number of accepted tokens in request b

generation.mtp.attention.gqa.equation: C = Softmax(CausalMask(Qr Kr^T / sqrt(256))) V_cache with 32 query heads sharing 2 KV heads

generation.mtp.attention.kv_cache.write.equation: KV_next = Append(KV_cache,Kr,V) at current token positions

generation.mtp.attention.partial_rope.equation: Qr,Kr = RoPE(Qn,Kn) on the configured 25 percent rotary subspace; remaining channels pass through

generation.mtp.attention.project_qkv.equation: [Q,K,V,G] = X W_qkvg^T with Q,G:[N,32,256] and K,V:[N,2,256]

generation.mtp.concat.equation: EH = Concat(En,Hn,axis=hidden) in R^(B x T x 8192)

generation.mtp.fc_projection.equation: X_draft = EH W_eh^T with W_eh in R^(4096 x 8192)

generation.mtp.moe.routed_experts.equation: Y_e = W2_e(SiLU(W1_e X_e) elementwise_mul W3_e X_e) for each of 512 routed experts

generation.mtp.moe.router_topk.equation: p = Softmax(X W_router^T); expert_ids = TopK(p,10); weights = Gather(p,expert_ids)

generation.mtp.moe.shared_expert.equation: Y_shared = W2_s(SiLU(W1_s X) elementwise_mul W3_s X)

generation.mtp.next_iteration.equation: repeat draft and verify from context_next until termination

generation.mtp.shared_lm_head.equation: draft_logits = Yn W_lm^T using the target LM head

generation.mtp.tentative_state.equation: journal := tentative KV appends plus raw GDN transitions produced during target verification

generation.mtp.verify_journal.equation: journal := uncommitted target KV appends and GDN transitions for all candidate positions

generation.mtp_loop.equation: accepted_tokens, committed_state = VerifyAndCommit(Target, MTPDraft, committed_state) when MTP is enabled

generation.state.read.equation: context,state := currently committed tokens and per-layer states

model.optional_vision_inputs.equation: pixel_patches, grid := optional packed image/video inputs

model.token_ids.equation: token_ids := request token ids with shape [B,T]

qwen3_5.attention.gqa.equation: C = Softmax(CausalMask(Qr Kr^T / sqrt(256))) V_cache with 32 query heads sharing 2 KV heads

qwen3_5.attention.kv_cache.write.equation: KV_next = Append(KV_cache,Kr,V) at current token positions

qwen3_5.attention.partial_rope.equation: Qr,Kr = RoPE(Qn,Kn) on the configured 25 percent rotary subspace; remaining channels pass through

qwen3_5.attention.project_qkv.equation: [Q,K,V,G] = X W_qkvg^T with Q,G:[N,32,256] and K,V:[N,2,256]

qwen3_5.decode_state.equation: state_next = AppendOrUpdate(state_prev, per-layer KV, convolution windows, and GDN recurrent matrices)

qwen3_5.decoder.full_attention_moe_layer.equation: A = X + GatedGQA(RMSNorm(X)); Y = A + MoE(RMSNorm(A))

qwen3_5.decoder.gdn_moe_layer.equation: A = X + GDN(RMSNorm(X)); Y = A + MoE(RMSNorm(A))

qwen3_5.gdn.equation: Delta_attn, conv_next, S_next = GDN(Xn, conv_prev, S_prev)

qwen3_5.gdn.recurrence.equation: S_t = exp(-softplus(A_t)) elementwise_mul S_(t-1) + sigmoid(B_t) k_t outer (v_t - S_(t-1)^T k_t); O_t = S_t^T q_t

qwen3_5.hybrid_decoder.equation: X_60 = DecoderStack(X_0), applying GDN on 45 layers and full GQA on layers 3+4k

qwen3_5.lm_head.equation: logits = Y W_lm^T with untied W_lm in R^(248320 x 4096)

qwen3_5.moe.routed_experts.equation: Y_e = W2_e(SiLU(W1_e X_e) elementwise_mul W3_e X_e) for each of 512 routed experts

qwen3_5.moe.router_topk.equation: p = Softmax(X W_router^T); expert_ids = TopK(p,10); weights = Gather(p,expert_ids)

qwen3_5.moe.shared_expert.equation: Y_shared = W2_s(SiLU(W1_s X) elementwise_mul W3_s X)

qwen3_5.multimodal_injection.equation: X[vision_token_positions] = X_vision; other X positions retain X_text

qwen3_5.stack.input.equation: X_0 := embedded and optionally vision-injected hidden states [B,T,H]

qwen3_5.stack.schedule.equation: for l=0..59: attention_l = GDN if l mod 4 != 3 else causal GQA

qwen3_5.state.attention_keys.equation: K_l := committed full-attention keys [B,2,S,256] for each of 15 layers

qwen3_5.state.attention_values.equation: V_l := committed full-attention values [B,2,S,256] for each of 15 layers

qwen3_5.state.gdn_conv.equation: conv_l := committed three-sample Q/K/V windows [B,12288,3] for each of 45 GDN layers

qwen3_5.state.gdn_recurrent.equation: S_l := committed recurrent matrices [B,64,128,128] float32 for each of 45 GDN layers

qwen3_5.token_embedding.equation: X_text = Embedding[token_ids], Embedding in R^(248320 x 4096)

qwen3_5.vision_frontend.equation: X_vision = VisionEncoder27(pixel_patches, grid) in R^(M x 4096)

vision.input.equation: vision_input := packed patches [P,3,2,16,16] and grid metadata

vision.merger_fc1.equation: U = Xn W_merge1^T + b_merge1 in R^(M x 1152)

vision.merger_fc2.equation: X_vision = A W_merge2^T + b_merge2 in R^(M x 4096)

vision.patch_projection.equation: X_patch = Conv3D(pixel_patches; kernel=stride=(2,16,16)) in R^(P x 1152)

vision.spatial_group.equation: X_group[m] = Concat(X_encoded[p] for p in one 2x2 spatial group)

vision_block.fc1.equation: U = An W_1^T + b_1 in R^(P x 4304)

vision_block.fc2.equation: Delta_mlp = M W_2^T + b_2 in R^(P x 1152)
